scholarships.name: Erasmus Mundus Joint Master Programme in Imaging
scholarships.notes:
*** Tow State of Application:
	1. First stage applications are shortlisted after an eligibility check by partner university.  Shortlisted applicants also need to apply to Politecnico di Milano to ensure POLIMI admission. 
Only Required to Shortlisted Applicants.
Will be notified by mid-February(prv.year.they.do) with all instructions.
Applicants of the first application round will receive the final selection results by April 2026.
	2. Second stage : Shortlisted candidates will be invited for an online interview, preliminary in mid-March.

Requirement:
Bachelor's Degree : 
30 ECTS Math 
90 ETC CS Course
IELTS : 6.0
CV - 2 Page
Motivation Letter - 2000 Characters - PDF
Scanned Copy of Original Bachelor's Degree Certificate
Scanned Copy of Original Bachelor's Transcript.
One Recommendation Letter - PDF
Copy of Passport
Selection Criteria:
Academic Excellence and CV
Motivation Letter
Recommendation Letter's
